test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can finish a work in 15 days and B can finish the same work in 20 days. Working together, in how many days can they finish the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can finish a work in 15 days and B can finish the same work in 20 days.

**Concept used:**

If A and B alone can finish a work in x and y days, respectively, then the reciprocal of the number of days taken by them to finish the work while working together is (1)/(x)+(1)/(y)

**Calculation:**

Let A and B, together can finish the work in x days.

Then, (1)/(x)=(1)/(15)+(1)/(20)

Solving for x,

x=(15×20)/(15+20)=8.57

**∴ Working together, A and B can finish the same work in 8.57 days.**
